title: Hierarchical Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Alignment via Dynamic Granularity Discovery and Optimal Transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.30912v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. translated_title: 基于动态粒度发现与最优传输的层次化细粒度跨模态对齐
translated_abstract: 细粒度图文检索不仅要求模型评估图像与文本之间的全局语义一致性，还需要模型为局部文本语义（包括对象、属性、数量、动作和关系）建模相应的视觉证据，以便区分语义相似的候选结果。现有方法通常使用固定的图像块、检测到的区域或文本标记作为基本匹配单元，然后通过最大池化、交叉注意力或相似度累积等方式聚合局部交互。这类策略在语义单元构建和全局匹配一致性方面仍存在局限。本文提出了一种层次化细粒度跨模态对齐框架，称为HFCMA。该框架逐步将低层的图像块和标记表示转化为自适应的视觉区域和文本短语，然后在全局检索评分过程中执行结构化的区域-短语匹配，……
tldr: 该论文提出层次化细粒度跨模态对齐框架HFCMA，通过动态粒度发现与最优传输，将低层图像块和文本标记逐步转化为自适应的视觉区域与文本短语，并在全局检索评分中实现结构化的区域-短语匹配，从而提升细粒度图文检索性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HFCMA, a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework that dynamically discovers adaptive granularities by progressively transforming low-level patches and tokens into visual regions and textual phrases, and performs structured region-phrase matching via optimal transport within a global retrieval scoring process for fine-grained image-text retrieval.
